description: PAID $0.001 USDC. One on-chain DeFi lending pool (Aave v3/Compound v3/Moonwell/Morpho Blue) by pool id protocol:chain:token_address, e.g. aave-v3:base:0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913: supply/borrow APY, utilization, TVL, impermanent-loss risk and risk score. Refreshed about every 30 min. Returns JSON for that pool: supply and borrow APY, utilization, TVL, impermanent-loss risk, and risk score.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

pool_id.description: Pool id. Format: protocol:chain:token_address. Example: aave-v3:base:0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913. Required.
